name: batch_decompile
description: Decompile each explicit procedure symbol or address, with one provider read active per batch. Preserves each input selector in address and reports the observed canonical entry and entry label in procedure; identity or label failures remain explicit without discarding usable pseudocode. Returns ordered per-item outcomes and aggregate counts. An unavailable item means the provider returned null pseudocode; its limitations retain any reported reason without asserting provider capability or retryability. Errors report failed operations or malformed output. Failed counts include unavailable items. The complete reply carries every pseudocode body. Select detail summary to retain the batch and receive only counts, then read rows or one body by index through inspect_analysis_view. A per-function limit is not a batch deadline; allow for every item or split calls.

detail.description: complete returns the complete analysis Evidence inline. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; inspect pages, items or facets through normalized_result.parent_evidence_id.
